notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/cinematronics/nl_starhawk.cpp (NETLIST_START(starhawk), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/starhawk-sound.nets.
This board's designators are column-and-row grid positions (IC5D, IC4A ...), written U5D, U4A here. MAME's file credits Jay Gallagher with verifying the PCB components.

Compared with the sheet, Schematic, Audio Board (Star Hawk) 2-30008 Rev X3, 1-9-79 (doc 87193443ac92 p43; a 300 dpi 1-bit scan read from the native image at 2-6x; the manual has no parts list), 2026-10-20: every IC's type and position; the J2 inputs (J2-11 explosion, J2-12 and J2-13 lazers, J2-14 K on/off, J2-15 master on/off, J2-16 K exit -- MAME's OUT_0-4 and OUT_7 in that order) with the 74LS04 6C and 7406 7C; the noise generator (6D, the 74LS164s 8C/8D/9C/9D, 9E, 10C/10D/10E, R1-R15, C7-C15, CR1, CR2, 6B and the CA3080 6A's inputs); the explosion one-shot and Q1 (R5, R7, R16, R17, C5, C6, C17); the killer-ship ramp, the 5D wobble oscillator and the ship VCO (R26-R38, CR3-CR6, C9, C20, C27, 4B, 5A, 5B); both lazer VCOs with their 74LS393 counters, 74S287 PROMs (the counter-to-PROM wiring read on 4E; 7E's tap numbers are illegible but wired the same) and DACs (R39-R60, C22-C26, CR7-CR10, Q4, Q5); and the TL182 3A with the summing node (6A pin 6, R19, C26, 3A pin 14, 3A pin 1 into 4A) all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value, diode and transistor orientation included. 5D pin 5 is not drawn, so RDUMMY stands in for an open output. MAME differs only at the final amplifier: R22 goes into 4C pin 2, its inverting input, where MAME grounds it (line 436); corrected above.

Labels that read wrongly on this scan but are MAME's designators by position: CR6 (reads like CR8), C26 (C28), R46 (R48). Not in this file: the final amplifier (4C, Q2, Q3, R20, R21, R23-R25, C16, C18, C19) and the regulators 2C and 2D, which are on the sheet with the values MAME's comments give.
conflicts: C21 (5D's timing capacitor, the ship-wobble rate) is printed "22 TANT 35V", 22uF. MAME uses 0.22uF, marked "PCB verified", and keeps the sheet's 22uF behind its SLOW_SHIP_WOBBLE debug switch (about 0.6 Hz against 60 Hz). This file follows MAME's board.
R6 (the explosion one-shot's timing resistor) is lettered "190K" against MAME's 150K; 190K is not a stock value and the print may be a slip. This file follows MAME.
